title: External dataset intake registry for RONIN-IA

policy.rule: Availability, free download, open access, dataset-level labels, or metadata licenses do not by themselves authorize training on full text.
policy.commercial_use_assumption: Treat commercial use as possible; exclude non-commercial-only and no-derivatives material unless project scope is explicitly changed and approved.
policy.quarantine: Unknown, mixed, publisher-specific, missing, or ambiguous rights remain quarantined.

datasets.name: PleIAs Common Corpus
datasets.access: Hugging Face dataset; filter metadata before streaming
datasets.notes: The pipeline queries the indexed Hugging Face Dataset Viewer API, not a full 4.49-TB stream. It caps records at 5,000 words/200 KB and accepts only exact Public Domain, US Federal Public Domain, CC0, CC BY 2/3/4 and MIT labels. A partial viewer index is recorded; per-document provenance and third-party content still require G-0.

datasets.name: PubMed Central Open Access Subset
datasets.access: PMC Cloud Service AWS world-readable bucket pmc-oa-opendata; anonymous HTTPS/S3, no credentials; legacy FTP packages retired 2026-08-26
datasets.ingest_mode: PMC Cloud per-version JSON metadata -> exact CC0/CC BY gate -> JATS XML with MD5 verification -> text-only extraction
datasets.notes: Resolve every article version using its JSON metadata object. Require is_pmc_openaccess=true, is_manuscript=false, is_historical_ocr=false, is_retracted=false, exact allowlisted license_code, and non-retracted publication type from Europe PMC. Convert official s3:// XML URL to HTTPS, verify URL MD5 and retain metadata ETag plus XML/text SHA-256. Exclude figures, tables, media, supplementary material, references and acknowledgements. Candidate-only; no training admission.

datasets.name: Harvard Caselaw Access Project
datasets.notes: Harvard Library describes CAP data as open use without limitations; capture the exact release terms and provenance. Cases run through 2020.

datasets.name: USPTO PatentsView
datasets.notes: Patent records and derived files are useful technical text; do not assume every embedded figure or third-party component is unrestricted.

datasets.name: Project Gutenberg
datasets.notes: Verify public-domain status in the project's applicable jurisdiction, edition, translation, and any editorial apparatus.

datasets.name: OpenAlex snapshot (metadata)
datasets.notes: CC0 metadata can support discovery, deduplication and domain mapping; it does not grant rights to linked papers.

datasets.name: OpenAlex full-text corpus
datasets.notes: Use work/location license fields. Exclude no-derivatives, non-commercial, other-OA and publisher-specific unknown terms under current default policy.

datasets.name: The Stack v1.2 / BigCode
datasets.notes: Code must retain repository/file provenance and original license obligations. Respect opt-outs, malicious-file exclusions, and keep code separate from natural-language corpus.

datasets.name: Wikimedia project dumps (Wikipedia etc.)
datasets.notes: Check project-specific terms, attribution and share-alike requirements; exclude non-text/media and material with incompatible rights.

datasets.name: Wikidata dumps
datasets.notes: A small automated CC0 sample is fetched by scripts/ingest_external_samples.py; preserve item/property/value identifiers and labels. Sample is not automatically admitted to training.

datasets.name: Stack Exchange Data Dump
datasets.notes: Preserve author/post attribution and applicable CC BY-SA version; verify dump snapshot and terms.

datasets.name: arXiv bulk papers and source
datasets.notes: Do not infer a blanket training license from public availability. Article and source-package rights vary.

datasets.name: Harvard Dataverse
datasets.notes: Each deposit has its own terms; many records are data rather than high-density prose.

datasets.name: CORE
datasets.notes: Aggregator access is not a blanket reuse license. Follow source repository license for every full text.

datasets.name: Common Crawl
datasets.notes: Use to discover sources or public-domain collections; do not train on raw crawl at scale without source-level rights and provenance.

datasets.name: OPUS parallel corpora
datasets.notes: Each subcorpus has its own source and license. Keep parallel alignment and provenance; do not treat OPUS as one licensed corpus.

datasets.name: IULA Spanish-English Technical Corpus
datasets.notes: High-value technical domains; free access is not sufficient evidence of training rights. Verify corpus terms and underlying texts.

datasets.name: Europarl parallel corpus
datasets.notes: Useful institutional argumentation and multilingual alignment; verify release-specific rights and source terms.

datasets.name: CLiGS Textbox
datasets.notes: Already represented in current literature corpus; do not duplicate.

datasets.name: CoNSSA
datasets.notes: Already represented in current literature corpus; not all source material is redistributable.

datasets.name: ELTeC-spa
datasets.notes: Already represented in current literature corpus; preserve existing train/validation/test split.

datasets.name: Europe PMC — abstracts with CC BY / CC0 license
datasets.notes: The intake script admits only explicit CC0/CC BY license labels and stores title, abstract, DOI/PMCID, authors, date and article URL. NC/ND/unknown licenses are excluded; sample still requires semantic and rights audit before training.
